items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: I was taking lessons from Professor J.B. Humphrey.

ctx.x: I have brothers, but none of them didn't take up no music. And I didn't take up music until around 1919. At that time I was around 17, 17 years old. And I started on the trombone. The trombone. And I was taking lessons from Professor J.B. Humphrey. Oh yes. Jim Humphrey. Jim Humphrey.
